candidates.change_summary: Replace nonReentrant_ modifier so it does not reset locked_ to false after function execution (removes unlocking), causing subsequent Put calls to revert.

Change Put so it sets acc.unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime unconditionally (removes floor to block.timestamp), allowing callers to set unlockTime in the past and affecting when funds become withdrawable.
Change Put to NOT update acc.balance (remove the balance addition), so Put no longer increases the caller's stored balance while still logging the deposit.

Replace the external call to send ether with a transfer to msg.sender using call with zero-length data but inverse success check so that state update happens even if the call failed (removes check on _s).
Move the balance decrement before the external call so the contract updates internal state prior to sending funds.
Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier body so it does not reset the lock after function execution (locked_ remains true), preventing reentrancy but also permanently locking functions using the modifier.
